A day for each feast

La Noche de Rabanos

A Home Celebration for La Noche de Rábanos

Bring the vibrant spirit of Oaxaca's Night of the Radishes into your home with this cozy, festive agenda. Celebrate the artistry and flavors of this unique winter festival.

  1. Morning (10:00 am)

    Radish Art Workshop

    Embrace the spirit of Oaxacan artisans by carving radishes into festive shapes or small scenes, just as they do for the competition.

  2. Afternoon (3:00 pm)

    Prepare the Feast

    Get all your ingredients ready for the traditional Oaxacan winter dinner, chopping and measuring for a smooth cooking process.

  3. Late Afternoon (5:00 pm)

    Cook the Main Dishes

    Begin preparing the savory radish tamales and the comforting epazote green atole, filling your home with their inviting aromas.

    Recipes: Radish and Quesillo Tamales · Epazote Green Atole

  4. Early Evening (6:30 pm)

    Assemble Salad & Champurrado

    Whisk together the vibrant radish salad with lime and cilantro, and simmer the rich, thick cocoa and masa champurrado.

    Recipes: Oaxacan Radish and Lime Salad · Thick Cocoa and Masa Champurrado

  5. Evening (7:30 pm)

    Cena Tradicional Oaxaqueña de Invierno

    Gather to enjoy your homemade feast, including the optional sweet pineapple and raisin tamales for dessert, celebrating the flavors of Oaxaca.

    Recipes: Oaxacan Radish and Lime Salad · Radish and Quesillo Tamales · Epazote Green Atole · Thick Cocoa and Masa Champurrado · Sweet Pineapple and Raisin Tamales

  6. Late Evening (9:00 pm)

    Mezcal & Reflection

    Conclude your evening with sips of artisanal mezcal, served traditionally with orange slices and sal de gusano, reflecting on the day's festivities.

    Recipes: Traditional Mezcal Service for La Noche de Rábanos

May your home be filled with the warmth and wonder of this special Oaxacan tradition.
